tooltip.createcinema.display_upgrade.2: The projector shows Display Link text on the screen instead of video. A film and this upgrade can coexist, but video playback is disabled.

tooltip.createcinema.config_manager.3: Douyin and iQiyi use separate local browser profiles and authorization states.

tooltip.createcinema.screen.2: See the Kinetic Projector Ponder tutorial for the complete setup.

tooltip.createcinema.black_screen.2: See the Kinetic Projector Ponder tutorial for the complete setup.

createcinema.ponder.tag.cinema.descripti: Burners, kinetic projectors, screens, network projectors, and speakers
createcinema.ponder.film_burning.text_1: The Film Burner writes a local video onto a blank film. Insert a blank film, then enter the video path.
createcinema.ponder.film_burning.text_2: Choose a quality preset and start processing. The film remains in the burner while it is being written.
createcinema.ponder.film_burning.text_3: Remove the film when complete. The burner only creates film; a Kinetic Projector plays it.
createcinema.ponder.projector_setup.head: Kinetic Projector and Screens
createcinema.ponder.projector_setup.text: The Kinetic Projector searches forward for screens. The valid distance is 1 to 16 blocks.
Screens can mix white and black screen blocks. The projector detects one connected screen matrix.
The projector needs valid speed. 64 rpm is 1x; overstress or 0 rpm stops playback.
Each upgrade slot accepts one card and is reserved for projector extensions.
createcinema.ponder.network_audio.text_1: Right-click the Network Projector, enter a video URL, and save.
createcinema.ponder.network_audio.text_2: Build a screen matrix in front. White and black screens can mix. The Network Projector also supports video projection.
createcinema.ponder.network_audio.text_3: Connect speakers to the Network Projector with cables. Spatial audio plays from each speaker's position.
createcinema.ponder.network_audio.text_4: Speaker volume is controlled linearly by redstone strength 0 to 15. At 0, the stream keeps advancing silently.
createcinema.ponder.network_audio.text_5: A Continuous Play Upgrade detects multipart videos or episode lists and plays through the final entry.
